description: Apply primary keys, foreign keys, NOT NULL, and DEFAULTs to target tables (typically post-data-load). Reads constraints from source INFORMATION_SCHEMA, executes ALTER TABLEs on target. Emits per-constraint status DataFrame.

inputs.description: Reads source INFORMATION_SCHEMA for constraint metadata

outputs.description: Per-constraint status: schema_name, table_name, target_table, constraint_type, constraint_name, columns, status, error_message, ddl

source_connection_env_var.description: Env var with source SQLAlchemy URL. Set this OR source_connection.
source_connection_env_var.label: Source Connection Env Var

target_connection_env_var.description: Env var with target SQLAlchemy URL. Set this OR target_connection.
target_connection_env_var.label: Target Connection Env Var

schemas.description: Source schemas to scan for constraints
schemas.label: Source Schemas

include_patterns.description: fnmatch-style glob patterns (case-insensitive) against qualified table names. Examples: ['HR.*'], ['HR.EMPLOYEES', 'FINANCE.STG_*']. Default: include all discovered tables.
include_patterns.label: Include Patterns

exclude_patterns.description: fnmatch-style glob patterns to exclude. Applied AFTER include_patterns.
exclude_patterns.label: Exclude Patterns

target_schema.description: Override target schema (defaults to source schema name)
target_schema.label: Target Schema Override

table_replacements.description: FK reference rewrites (old qualified name → new)
table_replacements.label: FK Table Replacements

constraint_types.label: Constraint Types
constraint_types.description: Subset of: primary_key, foreign_key, not_null, default, check, unique

dry_run.label: Dry Run
dry_run.description: Try every ALTER in a transaction then ROLLBACK — no state change.

fail_on_any_error.description: If true, asset fails on any constraint failure. Default: report and succeed.
fail_on_any_error.label: Fail On Any Error

deps.description: Upstream asset keys (typically the data replications)
deps.label: Deps

name: Database Constraints Migration
